description: Current-state cloud security discovery questionnaire supporting a Cloud Security Posture Assessment. Every question is mandatory and is phrased natively for the cloud platform selected for the organization during onboarding (Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform).

response_model.logic: Each question requires a written current-state response. All 60 responses are mandatory. Where a question does not apply, state "Not Applicable" together with a one-line reason. Where the answer is not known, state "Unknown, to be confirmed" rather than leaving it blank.

instructions: Answer every question in the response box beneath it. All 60 questions are mandatory.
If a question does not apply to your organization, enter "Not Applicable" and a one-line reason.
If you do not know the answer, enter "Unknown, to be confirmed" rather than leaving it blank — that is itself useful information.
Where possible, reference or attach supporting documents rather than retyping their contents.
Attach supporting evidence against any question where a document, export or screenshot substantiates the answer.

disclaimer.title: CSPM - Acceptance
disclaimer.intro: Please read the following disclaimers carefully. Acknowledgement is mandatory before the questionnaire can be submitted.
items: The assessment is based solely on the {p} environment, configurations, and information made available by the client.
The assessment is advisory and consultative in nature and does not constitute an audit opinion or certification.
The findings represent the security posture as observed during the assessment period only.
Recommendations are based on recognised industry practices, applicable standards, and published {p} security guidance.
The assessment does not guarantee the complete identification or elimination of all security risks.
The assessment team is not responsible for implementing configuration or remediation changes; any impact arising from client-implemented changes remains the responsibility of the client.
The client is responsible for maintaining appropriate backups and recovery arrangements before making any changes arising from this assessment.
Assessment results depend on the accuracy and completeness of the information and access provided by the client.
Security findings may change as a result of modifications to {p} services, environment configurations, the threat landscape, or newly released platform security features.
The assessment does not constitute a guarantee of regulatory or contractual compliance.
Client data and assessment information will be handled as confidential information, subject to the agreed contractual terms.
Production resources will not be intentionally modified, deleted, or disrupted during the assessment.
Penetration testing, exploitation, and other intrusive security testing are excluded unless explicitly authorized and separately scoped in writing.
Third-party services and applications outside the {p} environment are excluded from the scope of this assessment.
Final risk acceptance and risk treatment decisions remain with the authorized management of the client.
Liability, confidentiality, data protection, and governing-law obligations are subject to the executed contract, non-disclosure agreement, or statement of work.
English shall be the default language for all communications, documentation, reports, deliverables, and correspondence related to this assessment, unless otherwise agreed in writing by both parties.
disclaimer.acknowledgement: I confirm that I am authorized to submit this questionnaire on behalf of my organization, that the responses provided are accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge, and that I have read, understood and accept the disclaimers set out above.
